# Security policy

Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/JH3lou/GridCue/security/advisories/new). Please don't disclose them publicly until we have had a reasonable chance to investigate and fix them.

In scope: any way GridCue could change data instead of views, apply a plan that failed validation, leak row data or credentials to a provider or the browser, or be steered by crafted Utterances or schema text.
